scope.quote: `_createCampaign` never enforces that `startTimestamp` (or end time) is in the future. An operator with creator allowance can create a campaign that already ended; the contract still pulls tokens from the creator into Distributor, but no Merkle root will ever be produced for the finished campaign, leaving funds idle and unrecoverable by the creator.

- `_createCampaign` checks only `duration >= HOUR` and whitelist/min amounts; it omits `startTimestamp >= block.timestamp` and `startTimestamp + duration > block.timestamp` (DistributionCreator.sol:526-543).
- `_pullTokens` immediately transfers campaign funds to Distributor even if the campaign is already over (DistributionCreator.sol:585-607).
